name: 海洋5
english_description: Another branch of the “Ocean” code line — related to hy in this project but heavily diverged in content (line counts differ substantially, so fixes cannot be assumed to sit at matching locations). It's a wuxia-themed world whose community calls itself “Ocean V.” Its adm/obj/master.lpc is byte-identical to hy's, but its security daemon (adm/daemons/securd.lpc) has been independently rewritten — the two share a common source root, but their security models diverge considerably in implementation.
